about: Rumplestiltskin is a still of a tiny, pale fairy-tale imp with wild blond hair, a glossy sequined tuxedo jacket and a bow tie, mid-step on a straw-covered barn floor with his arms flung out wide. He looks delighted with himself, like he has just pulled off a dance move nobody asked to see. The frame comes from an AI-generated clip styled like an old 1980s fantasy film, and it is used for smug, prancing confidence: someone strutting around after a small win or showing up uninvited and very pleased about it.
origin: The clip was an AI-generated video of Rumplestiltskin dancing for a princess, posted by several Instagram meme pages in late August 2026 and later paired with Riff Raff's song "Tip Toein' In My Jordans". It spread on TikTok and Instagram as a dancing edit before imgflip users turned the still into a template.
usage:
Top box: the situation that makes him dance, written as "me when..." or a quick setup. Bottom box: the smug punchline, a demand, or the little secret he is gloating over, in keeping with the fairy tale's name-guessing bargain.

It fits petty victories, sneaky deals and people who are far too proud of themselves: guessing a password, finishing a chore early, winning an argument on a technicality. The sillier and smaller the win, the better the strut reads.
ideas: me when someone guesses my wifi password
me after doing one load of laundry
when the trade deal includes your firstborn
and you didn't read the terms
me tiptoeing past my parents' room
the intern after fixing the printer
when you're the only one who did the reading
and the teacher asks a question
aka: Tip Toein' in My Jordans Rumpelstiltskin
